note: RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 Established state requires tearing down on NOTIFICATION (Events 24, 25) or TcpConnectionFails (Event 18): zero ConnectRetryTimer, delete connection routes, release BGP resources, drop TCP, increment ConnectRetryCounter by 1, enter Idle. Reactor TestRFC4271EstablishedNotificationOrTCPFailureReleasesTheConnection exercises NOTIFICATION 2/1, Cease 6/2, and far-end TCP close on a live Established Peer (verifying peer-down, session release, all three timers stopped, counter 0->1, no NOTIFICATION reply, and EOF); FSM tests verify Event 24 counter increment in Connect/Active/Established vs quiet in OpenSent/OpenConfirm; RIB TestRFC4760PeerDownDeletesOnlyThatNeighborsRoutes verifies peer-down deletes only the departed PeerOwner's routes; negative keeps Established on KEEPALIVE and valid UPDATE with counter 0.
